title: Image-Conditional Diffusion Transformer for Underwater Image Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2407.05389v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) has attracted much attention owing to its importance for underwater operation and marine engineering. Motivated by the recent advance in generative models, we propose a novel UIE method based on image-conditional diffusion transformer (ICDT). Our method takes the degraded underwater image as the conditional input and converts it into latent space where ICDT is applied. ICDT replaces the conventional U-Net backbone in a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) with a transformer, and thus inherits favorable properties such as scalability from transformers. Furthermore, we train ICDT with a hybrid loss function involving variances to achieve better log-likelihoods, which meanwhile significantly accelerates the sampling process. tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图像条件扩散变压器（ICDT）的水下图像增强新方法，通过用变压器替换传统U-Net骨干并使用混合损失函数，实现了更好的可扩展性和更快的采样速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel underwater image enhancement method based on an image-conditional diffusion transformer (ICDT), which replaces the traditional U-Net backbone with a transformer and uses a hybrid loss function to achieve better scalability and faster sampling.
